description: Returns one preset in full: its summary and Strategy Tester results, the Strategy Tester properties to set (initial capital, commission, slippage), its contracts, the strategy's page, and every input value keyed by its exact label on the TradingView chart. It is the tool for explaining a preset's settings or results, or setting it up by hand; list_presets finds presets and export_preset returns their files. Returns an error message if the preset_id is unknown or not available to this account. Read-only.

preset_id.description: The preset_id of one preset, as returned by list_presets
